data.narrative:
Orbital Composites is a seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Cole Nielsen and Amolak Badesha that has raised $6.6M+. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of one public company (277810.KQ) and eight private peers in robotics and manufacturing, including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI.

The stage-progression method is the primary applicable valuation approach. Using total capital raised of $6.6M as a proxy for seed-stage valuation, a 2.5x step-up multiplier to the next financing round produces an implied valuation of $16.5M. Peer-median triangulation could not be applied due to insufficient datapoints at comparable stage and tier; while ten peers exist in the sector, fewer than three met narrow filters for same-stage or adjacent-stage comparison, making an all-sector median unreliable.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $14M (low) to $19M (high), with a median point of $16M. This range reflects the 2.5x multiplier applied to a $7M baseline derived from total raised. Key uncertainties include the limited depth of stage-specific comps in robotics and manufacturing—peer-median validation remains unavailable—and the inherent volatility in seed-stage step-up assumptions. Additional data on recent rounds among Seed-to-Series A cohort peers would strengthen conviction in the range midpoint.
